about: The first DVT followed major surgery. Follow-up records recovery and no continuing indication. The first linked apixaban supply and a later supply show treatment beyond 6 months.
Possible finding: apixaban supplies extend beyond 6 months. The record gives no DVT history, cause, recovery, continuing indication or start of treatment linked to a DVT.
Rivaroxaban supplies for a first DVT are followed by warfarin with INR-chart directions. Antiphospholipid syndrome is a continuing clotting risk, so the uncertain duration does not warrant a finding.
